summary: Sixth session of test fixes for the whole PRD. It took AC-SEE-04, the last Weak row being worked. A coloured kiln run now pins the Located line's grey rest as the engine makes it, and the settings while Kiln works are compared with a row the person told Kiln about, proving they never offer Change. Both new tests were seen to fail with the behaviour broken, and a fresh reviewer graded AC-SEE-04 Adequate. Every criterion is now Adequate except AC-ASK-06, which stays stuck at Weak and waits on the person. The unit suite (1239 tests) passed, and the integration suite passed in four shards apart from one failure that was already there: src/live/pause-now-withheld.integration.test.ts (AC-PAUSE-02, another PRD's criterion) reports "Kiln is checking, dispatching or reconciling an instruction." where it expects the Pause now reason. Only test files changed.
